data.name: Musanna
data.gender_notes: Musanna is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Musanna is an Arabic name that signifies strength, firmness, and steadfastness. It is derived from the Arabic root 's-n-n', which means 'to be firm' or 'to be strong'. In Islamic tradition, Musanna is considered a virtuous name that represents a strong and unwavering faith. The name Musanna carries the meaning “Firm, Strong, and Steadfast” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Musanna usually hope their child will grow to embody firm, strong, and steadfast and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In the Quran, the concept of steadfastness is emphasized in Surah Al-Imran, Verse 146, which says, 'How many a small band has overcome a large band by Allah's leave? And Allah is with the steadfast.'
data.etymology: Musanna belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Firm, Strong, and Steadfast.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Musanna total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

It is believed that giving a child a strong name could influence and shape their character as they grow up. As a result, the name Musanna is often given to boys in the hope that they will embody the qualities of strength and firmness throughout their lives. Furthermore, the name Musanna can serve as a source of pride and inspiration for the bearer, reminding them of their heritage and the rich history of the Islamic civilization.

In the Quran, Allah (God) says, "And hold firmly to the rope of Allah all together and do not become divided. And remember the favor of Allah upon you and that which He has brought down to you of the Book and wisdom by which He instructs you. And fear Allah; and know that Allah is Knowing of that in your inner-selves" (3:103). The name Musanna is a reminder of this exhortation and serves as a constant reminder to the bearer to remain steadfast in their faith and to hold firmly to the laws and teachings of Islam. Moreover, the name Musanna can serve as a source of inspiration and encouragement during times of hardship and struggle. It reflects the belief that no matter what challenges one may face, with faith and determination, one can overcome them and emerge stronger and more resilient.
